title: pycnanthemum verticillatum var. pilosum
intro: Pycnanthemum verticillatum var. pilosum, commonly known as Pilos Pycnanthemum or Downy Mountain Mint, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory issues, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pilos Pycnanthemum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant has been traditionally used to relieve symptoms of colds, coughs, and sore throats, and is also used in herbal medicine to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation.
